## Permissions and metadata

## Screenshots

## Checklist

- [ ] The change was developed in a dedicated Git worktree and task branch targeting `main`.
- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] No secrets, tracking, or unnecessary dependencies were added.
- [ ] The root README index and relevant documentation are up to date.

## Review and merge

Wait for Codex review of the current head, address actionable findings and change requests, and pass required checks before using **Rebase and merge** pinned to the reviewed head SHA. Every new push requires a fresh review. After confirming the PR is merged, delete the remote and local task branches and remove the clean task worktree. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/KnowSky404/WebTweaks/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#required-worktree-and-pr-workflow) for the full workflow.
